items.html: We have already explained above that these things proceed by degree: for the breath of the ear is imperceptible and lesser than the breath that comes out of the nose, and the breath of the nose is less than the breath of the mouth; however, in this the three of them are equal, in that they give off breath. But the eye has no breath, only looking alone. And the reason for this difference is that the three are the aspect of Taamim, while the eye is the aspect of the Nekudot of SAG, which is below the level of the Taamim.
